notes.title: 《The Research Facility N0.507》updates to new version!
notes.content:
Dear friends:
We will update the game at 2017.6.10.It contains bug fixing and some more content.
Game content:
Take out your compass to find the tombs hidden deeply in the forest,LinHai Snowland and Gobi desert by your knowledge.Guns are your best friends.The rile,shot gun,machine gun with different swords can help you to defend various of enemies.

notes.title: 新噱头添加.
notes.content:
我之前在盐帮菜吃到了火爆肥肠还不错。
为此我做了口锅和灶台，猪除了掉肉，还有可能掉肥肠，然后还添加了辣椒这种植物 。 
但值得注意的是， 洗原料的过程一定不能省, 不然当你夹起一坨到嘴里之后，可能不会太愉悦..
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26580402/373f6d7014d5f6e2df08c205ff55127eae46b69f.jpg[/img]

注意这是噱头 ，不代表游戏有了烹饪系统。

notes.title: new stunt added in game.
notes.content:
hi, 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26580402/8e617433788fc7a8bc2081c757b0512ba78d7295.jpg[/img]
[list]

  [*]大家可以下河游泳了，注意水里的氧气消耗！

  [*]警惕河里的水生蜥蜴。

  [*]河边可能会有乌龟，乌龟很胆小，会缩进壳里。

  [*]乌龟在水里不能呼吸。

[/list]
